note: Acceptance-only audio fixtures. Bundled ONLY by builds that set LFT_ACCEPTANCE_DIAGNOSTICS=1 (metro.config.js, scripts/lib/diagnostics-gate.js); the release APK/AAB and the web export never carry them (scripts/check-diagnostics-export.ts). Each fixture is derived from a committed, baselined clip and keeps that clip's voice licence; provenance: registry entry acceptance-diagnostics-fixtures (testOnly). A fixture's bytes must differ from every shipped asset: the export check finds the fixture by its hash.
